**Round 15 (TM-B18 / D-24): PASS.** I found no bugs. All seven acceptance checks R15-1…R15-7 pass, and the real-app checks ran, so realVerified is true. Windows packaging is BLOCKED because it isn't available in the cloud; it isn't part of this round.

When a save writes the files but the reload after it fails, the app now says the tags were saved. It leaves the file rows as they were, keeps the typed values in the form and keeps Save enabled.

- **R15-1, file ownership:** only the 4 allowed files changed and there are no new files. The test file only adds lines; tests (a)–(i) and their helpers are unchanged. `handleSchemaChanged` is unchanged. A's run shows no refused edits. Two code changes sit outside `handleSave`, an import and a small message helper; Step 2 of the task allows the helper.
- **R15-2, red/green:** on the old code (`a4ad852`), tests (j), (k) and (l) fail on the raw error text and the other 10 pass. On A's code all 13 pass.
- **R15-3, mutants:** I broke the fix six ways (M1s, M1b, M2, M3, M4, M5) and the tests caught every one.

  | Mutant | Caught by |
  |---|---|
  | M1s | (l) |
  | M1b, M2, M3 | (j) and (k) |
  | M4 | (l) |
  | M5 | (m) |

- **R15-4, full gate from a clean state:** exit 0.
  - Biome has 9 warnings, the same list as on `a4ad852`.
  - Type check has 0 errors.
  - Renderer tests 120/120, main 76/76.
  - E2E 7/7, and 7/7 again with `--retries=0`.
- **R15-5, real app with the reload forced to fail:** I replaced the reload handler in the running app so it throws; no source changed. Afterwards I relaunched without the injection and reopened the same folder.

  | Case | Message shown (exactly one) | Rows, form and Save button | ffprobe and music-metadata |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Batch | `Tags saved to 2 files, but reloading failed. Rescan to refresh.` | rows unchanged, `R15Batch` still typed, Save enabled | `ICAT=R15Batch` on both files |
  | Single | `Tags saved, but reloading failed. Rescan to refresh.` | row unchanged, `R15Single` still typed, Save enabled | `ICAT=R15Single` |
  | Old build, batch | `Error invoking remote method 'meta:read-batch': Error: R15 injected` | — | `R15Batch` written anyway, so the bug was real |

  After the relaunch, the rows show `Tagged` and the form shows the new values.
- **R15-6, regressions without injection:**
  - The batch save shows `Tags saved to 2 files` and clears the form.
  - The single save shows `Tags saved`.
  - In the batch with one file locked by `chmod 000`, the message is `1 saved, 1 failed` and the locked row keeps `Tagged`. The readers show the other file got the new value and the locked file kept its old one. All values were confirmed in both readers.
- **R15-7, docs:** both new paragraphs in `data-flow.md` are in Georgian and match the code. The one added line in `STATE_MANAGEMENT.md` is the task's exact text.

**Two caveats:**
- The real-app runs used the build that the gate's E2E step produced from A's code, not a separate `npm run build`. Re-editing `c-round-15.md` to say so was refused, so that note is in `c-round-15/build-provenance.md`.
- In R15-5 the copied test files had no tags. So "rows keep their badge" means they stayed untagged instead of switching to `Tagged`. The relaunch shows they would have switched if the app had updated them.

**Two observations, not bugs in this round:**
- The error message covers the Save button in the bottom-right corner for its 3 seconds. That layout is older than this round.
- If no file was written and the reload also fails, the message reads "0 saved, N failed. Reloading failed. …". It matches the task but reads awkwardly; A noted this too.

Application source was not changed during my phase, and my temporary worktrees are removed.
